description.value: Beeryani Indian Cuisine is a full-service Indian restaurant on Vancouver's Main Street, known for its signature 'Beeryani' — a fusion dish blending traditional slow-cooked biryani with locally brewed Canadian craft beer. The menu spans tandoor-grilled proteins, rich curries, and vegetarian staples like Dal Makhani, rounded out by curated craft beer pairings suggested by staff. The restaurant also offers catering for events of all sizes.
